يجترم (form VIII)
# يَجْتَرِمُ (yajtarimu) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ri.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# يُجْتَرَمُ (yujtaramu) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ra.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# يَجْتَرِمَ (yajtarima) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ri.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
